description: This file contains comprehensive unit tests for the React component OldTeams, covering various aspects such as creation, UI states, role-based rendering, and helper functions. It uses testing-library/react and vitest for mocking and assertions.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Simulates the logic for creating a new team, especially the handling of organization_id field by trimming, validation, or setting to null when empty or invalid.

methods.name: getAdminOrganizations
methods.description: Returns the list of organizations based on user role, filtering for org_admin members if role is 'Org Admin'.

methods.name: canCreateOrManageTeams
methods.description: Determines if the user has permissions to create or manage teams based on their role.
